cheats.name: Skip server authentication
cheats.description: 알바타이쿤2 waits forever for a response from its retired LGT authentication server. These patches complete the pending request locally and accept it as a successful SASH response so the game reaches the main menu.
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: dispatch any active authentication request once instead of waiting for network state 27
accept the pending request as the successful SASH response
